title: GlobalStorage2
description: Advanced shared storage with infinite stacking, auto-categorization, and chest automation
body:
# 🗄️ GlobalStorage2 - Advanced Shared Storage System

## 🌟 Overview

GlobalStorage2 revolutionizes item storage with a server-wide shared system featuring infinite stacking, automatic categorization, and advanced automation features!

## ✨ Core Features

### Shared Storage System
- **Global Access** - All players share one massive storage
- **Infinite Stacking** - Store billions of items per stack
- **Portable Access** - Use special stick anywhere
- **Smart Search** - Find items instantly
- **Multi-Page GUI** - Easy navigation

### 10 Auto-Categories
Items automatically sort into:
- **Building Blocks** - Construction materials
- **Colored Blocks** - Decorative blocks
- **Natural Blocks** - Natural materials
- **Functional Blocks** - Workstations
- **Redstone** - Circuits & components
- **Tools** - All tools & utilities
- **Combat** - Weapons & armor
- **Food** - Edibles & potions
- **Materials** - Crafting items
- **Misc** - Everything else

### Automation Features
- **Auto-Storage Chests** - Items transfer automatically
- **Transfer Filters** - Per-player auto-transfer rules
- **World Restrictions** - Control where it works
- **Auto-Save** - Data saves every 5 minutes

## 🎮 How It Works

### Access Storage
1. Get stick: `/gs give`
2. Right-click to open
3. Browse by category
4. Search for items
5. Take what you need

### GUI Controls
- **Left Click** - Take 1
- **Right Click** - Take 64
- **Shift+Left** - Take all
- **Q** - Custom amount
- **Middle** - Take half

### Auto-Chests
- Set with `/gs setchest`
- Items auto-transfer
- Multiple chests supported
- Admin-only setup

### Filter System
- Open with `/gs tensou`
- Add items to filter
- Auto-transfers from inventory
- Per-player settings

## 📋 Commands

- `/gs give` - Get access stick
- `/gs open` - Direct access (admin)
- `/gs sort` - Sort items (admin)
- `/gs setchest` - Setup auto-chest (admin)
- `/gs tensou` - Filter management
- `/gs listchests` - View all chests (admin)
- `/gs ngworld` - Disable in world (admin)

## ⚙️ Configuration
```yaml
# Disable in specific worlds
ng-worlds:
  - "pvp_world"
  - "minigame_world"
```

## 🔑 Permissions
- `gs.use` - Basic usage (Everyone)
- `gs.admin` - Admin features (OP)

## 📦 Requirements
- Paper/Spigot 1.21+
- Java 21+

## 💾 Data Storage
- JSON format
- Auto-saves
- Manual save option
- Reliable persistence

## 💡 Perfect For
- Community servers
- SMP servers
- Creative servers
- Resource sharing
- Storage optimization
